fusions.name: Tightening Knot
fusions.desc: A crushing bite that deals 14 poison damage, stuns the target for 1.2 seconds and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for each affliction already on the target, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Grip and Bite
fusions.desc: A held bite that deals 5 poison damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds, with a 20% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 1 second.

fusions.name: Steady on the Fang
fusions.desc: Increases your critical damage by 30% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Patient Grip
fusions.desc: When you have gone a while without a critical hit, your critical hit chance rises 25% for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
